slo_title: Define CPU scheduling and its purpose in multiprogramming systems

mcq.q: What does dispatch latency refer to?

options.A: Time taken for CPU to be idle
options.B: Time taken for CPU to switch from I/O to processing
options.C: Time taken to stop one process and start another
options.D: Time taken by CPU to boot

mcq.answer_text: Time taken to stop one process and start another

mcq.q: In which case is CPU scheduling said to be non-preemptive?

options.A: A process switches from ready to running
options.B: A process is interrupted by a higher priority process
options.C: A process terminates after completing CPU burst
options.D: A process moves from waiting to ready

mcq.answer_text: A process terminates after completing CPU burst

mcq.q: Which of the following is minimized in efficient CPU scheduling?
What is the unit of measurement for throughput?
What does CPU Utilization aim to achieve?

options.C: Keep the CPU as busy as possible

mcq.answer_text: Keep the CPU as busy as possible

sq.q: Define "Turnaround Time" and mention its formula.
answer: Definition of Turnaround Time (in own words): "It is the total time taken to execute a process from the time it is submitted until it is completed. 50%
